description: List all database connections from both dockit and sqlkit. Each entry has { backend, id, name, type } — use id as connection_id when calling database tools. Call this when a task needs to read/query a database (row counts, table contents, schema) to pick the right connection before executing SQL — never fall back to psql/mysql CLIs. If no connections appear, call data_studio__get_status. Report results in the user's language (中文/English).
name: data_studio__list_connections
title: List Connections
